name: wilt100
caption:
100 POINTS 🎮🏀 Only one player has ever scored 100 in an NBA game. He was one of us.

• March 2, 1962: Wilt Chamberlain, Philadelphia Warriors, vs the Knicks
• 36 of 63 from the field, 28 of 32 from the line
• We win 169-147
• Closest since: Bam Adebayo's 83 in March 2026
• Steph's career high: 62

Will anyone ever score 100 again? 👇

beats.head: 100 POINTS
beats.name: WILT
beats.vo: Only one player has ever scored a hundred points in an NBA game. He played for us: Wilt Chamberlain.
beats.dlg: ONLY ONE MAN EVER HIT 100.|HE PLAYED FOR US.

beats.head: WILT'S NIGHT
beats.vo: Thirty-six of sixty-three from the field. Twenty-eight of thirty-two at the line, from a guy who usually shot about fifty percent.
beats.dlg: 36 OF 63 FROM THE FIELD.|28 OF 32 AT THE LINE!

beats.head: FINAL
beats.name: KNICKS
beats.vo: March second, nineteen sixty-two. We beat the Knicks, one sixty-nine to one forty-seven.

beats.head: THE CLOSEST
beats.name: BAM
beats.vo: The closest anyone has come since: Bam Adebayo's eighty-three last March. Steph's career high? Sixty-two.

beats.head: 100 AGAIN?
beats.vo: Will anyone ever score a hundred again? Comment below.

facts.claim: On March 2, 1962 Wilt Chamberlain scored 100 points for the Philadelphia Warriors in a 169–147 win over the New York Knicks at Hershey, Pennsylvania (PA); 36 of 63 field goals and 28 of 32 free throws, far better than his roughly 50% career average; only 1 player has done it; the closest since is Bam Adebayo's 83 on March 10, 2026
